notes.title: A few words about the nearest future.
notes.content:
Subscribe to the game's newsletter.  

The next major update will bring the following:
- Two new underground levels (for a total of 10 levels)
- 3 completely new enemies
- Lots of familiar enemies with updated appearance
- More fun

We'd like to thank all users who have or will purchase cards to support g the developers - it is very important for us. 

Do not forget to post reviews of the game, we are genuinely interested in knowing your opinion.
